mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% does not lead to a statistically significant negative 20-day forward return (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises > 0.5% in 1 month does not lead to a statistically significant negative 5-day forward return (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If HOUST increases do not lead to a statistically significant positive 60-day forward return (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals supply chain disruptions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO decreases > 1% MoM does not lead to a statistically significant negative 20-day forward return (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases do not lead to a statistically significant positive 20-day forward return (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases > 200,000 does not lead to a statistically significant positive 60-day forward return (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If RSAFS and HOUST both increase does not lead to a statistically significant positive 20-day forward return (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a decrease in GDP (GDPC1) signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 decreases during a monetary tightening cycle do not lead to a statistically significant negative 60-day forward return (t-test p > 0.05).
